age: Any age! All skill levels welcome!
description: Join Leopard Robotics for a hands-on engineering challenge where participants build a bridge and explore the basics of engineering, robotics, and physics in a fun, interactive way.
Explore exciting science concepts through hands-on activities designed to spark curiosity, encourage discovery, and make learning fun.
Enjoy a welcoming and interactive math workshop with approachable activities and puzzles that help participants build confidence and explore the joy of problem-solving.
